description: This line plot illustrates the GPU memory consumption in gigabytes (GB) for five different video understanding models—VideoLLaMB, VideoLLaMB-R, PLLaVA, LLava-NeXT, and VideoLLAVA—as a function of the number of video frames processed, ranging from 0 to 1000 on a linear x-axis. The y-axis, labeled "Memory (GB)", also uses a linear scale from 0 to 400 GB. The VideoLLaMB model is represented by a pink line with circular markers, starting at approximately 15 GB and rising to about 22 GB by 200 frames before leveling off. VideoLLaMB-R is shown as a gold line with circular markers, beginning near 15 GB and remaining nearly flat at around 25 GB across the entire frame range. PLLaVA is depicted with a green line and circular markers, starting at approximately 15 GB and increasing steadily to about 75 GB by 1000 frames. LLava-NeXT is represented by a blue line with circular markers, beginning near 15 GB and increasing linearly to approximately 145 GB at 1000 frames. The VideoLLAVA model is shown as a purple line with circular markers, starting at approximately 15 GB and exhibiting a steep, exponential-like increase, reaching over 400 GB by 300 frames and continuing to rise sharply beyond that point.
